what: Read and Losslessly Pack NCHS Natality Public-Use Files
title: Read and Losslessly Pack NCHS Natality Public-Use Files
text: Read losslessly pack NCHS natality public-use files. NCHS natality public-use file fixed-width text file — one record per birth, delimiters, quoting. defeats delimiter-sniffing readers data.table::fread(). nchsNatality reads file byte position official record layout, optionally converts compact, lossless sharded Parquet (via DuckDB), round-trips back fixed-width verification.

title: Read and Losslessly Pack NCHS Natality Public-Use Files
text: Runtime dependencies: data.table, vroom.Parquet functions additionally require duckdb >= 1.1.0 DBI.
code: # from GitHub remotes::install_github("vjcitn/nchsNatality")  # or from a local source checkout devtools::install("path/to/nchsNatality")

title: Read and Losslessly Pack NCHS Natality Public-Use Files
text: package assumes obtain data convert Parquet; everything downstream (analysis, analysis script share others) reads Parquet directory, original download. Read data-use agreement. downloading anything, read terms https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/data_access/vitalstatsonline.htm#Downloadable (see Legal ). Download unzip file. URL, download “U.S. Data” natality file year want (2025 year package currently bundles layout ; see natality_years()) unzip get fixed-width .txt file. Pack sharded Parquet. one-time, lossless conversion (verified natality_pack() ) directory compressed shards every later step queries directly: Point package directory. Either set environment variable visible R (e.g. .Renviron), every call resolves automatically: pass location explicitly single call, without setting environment variable: Analyze. pure data manipulation, query shards directly SQL via DuckDB: statistical analysis R, combine dplyr arrow/DuckDB heavy lifting runs Parquet shards (small) result pulled R, attach value labels label_natality(): See vignette("tidy-parquet-queries") fuller worked example, vignette("variable-dictionary") every field value labels. natality_unpack() reconstructs original fixed-width file Parquet directory, ever need back:
code: library(nchsNatality) f <- "Nat2025PublicUS.c20260624.r20260922.txt" check_natality_file(f)   # sanity-check line endings / record length natality_pack(f, out_dir = "/path/to/nat_parquet") #> Packing 12 shards (DOB_MM 01–12) … #> Verifying … OK Sys.setenv(NCHS_NAT_PARQUET = "/path/to/nat_parquet") dt <- read_natality(cols = c("MAGER", "DBWT", "COMBGEST", "SEX", "DOB_MM")) dt <- read_natality(parquet_dir = "/path/to/nat_parquet",                      cols = c("MAGER", "DBWT", "COMBGEST", "SEX", "DOB_MM")) con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb()) DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE VIEW nat AS SELECT * FROM '/path/to/nat_parquet/*.parquet'") DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) n FROM nat GROUP BY SEX") library(dplyr) nat <- arrow::open_dataset(Sys.glob(file.path(parquet_dir, "*.parquet"))) by_sex <- nat |>   filter(DBWT != 9999) |>   group_by(SEX) |>   summarise(n = n(), mean_dbwt = mean(DBWT)) |>   collect() |>   label_natality(cols = "SEX") natality_unpack("/path/to/nat_parquet", "Nat2025_copy.txt")

title: Read and Losslessly Pack NCHS Natality Public-Use Files
text: User Guide documents 1330-byte record. 2025 public release (Nat2025PublicUS.c20260624.r20260922.txt) 1345-byte records CRLF line endings; bytes 1331–1345 beyond documented layout. check_natality_file() reports automatically. natality_pack() detects actual record length keeps extra bytes trailing FILLER_1331 column, data lost. guide typographic errors; data-raw/parse_userguide.py lists corrections made layout value-label CSVs generated.

title: Read and Losslessly Pack NCHS Natality Public-Use Files
text: One year sharded Parquet compression level 22 roughly 500 MB 1 GB (actual size depends data). large GitHub repository (100 MiB hard limit per file; 1 GB soft limit per repo). Options: GitHub Releases – release assets can 2 GB . Git LFS – transparent large-file storage; free tier 1 GB. Zenodo / OSF / AWS S3 – public archival distribution.

title: Pack a natality file into compact, lossless, sharded Parquet — natality_pack
text: file Path fixed-width natality file. out_dir Directory shards storage.csv. base name used stem shard file names. shard_by Field shard . default, birth month, gives 12 files (plus one blank months, ). NULL writes single file. level zstd compression level, 1-22. High levels slow write slower read. row_group_size Rows per Parquet row group. sort_by Columns sort rows within shard. NULL uses natality_default_sort(); character(0) means sorting. int_codes Also store digit-categorical codes (e.g. MEDUC, MRACE15) integers. FALSE keeps character codes label_natality() expects. parquet_version "V1" (widely readable) "V2". max_mb Warn shard larger many MiB. verify Run natality_verify() writing. record_length Record length file, excluding line endings. NULL detects first 10,000 records; every record must length. memory_limit DuckDB memory limit, e.g. "8GB". year Data year; see natality_years().

title: Read the natality public-use file — read_natality
code: if (nchar(f <- Sys.getenv("NCHS_NAT_PATH"))>0) {   z <- read_natality(f, n_max = 10000)   z <- read_natality(f, cols = c("MAGER", "DBWT", "COMBGEST", "SEX"))   } else { "NCHS_NAT_PATH not set in visible environment" } #> [1] "NCHS_NAT_PATH not set in visible environment"
